This is one of our comics from Possession Hub!

Caleb, one of the top ranking adventurers in the kingdom, and his squire Dani return home victorious and with the spoils of another conquered dungeon. Caleb’s elven servant, Anya, eagerly welcomes them back. While Anya is sorting through her masters’ hard-earned loot, she discovers a certain stowaway that’s been waiting for just the right time to strike.
